note: English words people search for, tied to rows the dictionary already has (DECISIONS.md 2026-11-18, point 2). Search finds the row by the word, and the word gets its own 'How to say ... in Tongan' page. The row's displayed meaning never changes and book-vocabulary.json is not edited. Each row carries its support: the row's own meaning quoted from the data (a test fails if the data no longer says it), or a source and a place in it (a citation, never the source's wording). The same support is in audits/dictionary-search-2026-11-18/additions-evidence.tsv in the project folder.

support.source: EALD Bilingual Dictionary for ESL Beginners (NSW Dept of Education, 2001)
